cases.name: Nabila E. Neverette Bare
cases.about: Her Find-a-Grave said, "She was in the JROTC at Lakes High School and sang in the choir and played violin. She loved to bowl and go to the movies and get dressed up for formal dances. She is buried in her mother's hometown of La Chorrera, Panama."
cases.narrative: On 7/12/2005, her body was found in their kitchen. He had stabbed her at least 71 times with knives and a meat cleaver. About three dozen of the wounds were on her head and neck.
